rules.rule: MarketChronology main owner is upper bound minus one; before first raises unless clamp. Lower window [start,end) uses lower bounds at both endpoints; absent end uses physical length.
Reset time precedence is nonempty second_time, display_time, native timestamp; no invented precision.

Reaction confirmation scans [valid intrabar start,Break open + timeframe), strict high above BoxTop bullish / low below BoxBottom bearish. Invalid start and absent crossing fall back to Break open. A disables intrabar start.
Lower extreme uses half-open position range; invalid/empty raises; equal price selects earliest position.
First crossing clamps bounds and visits intervals chronologically. Cached evidence excludes final mutable lower row from settled history. Cached crossing must be strictly before requested right.
Gate owner on same main candle qualifies if confirmation <= exact gate; without exact gate use Break index <= gate. Missing lower confirmation uses Break open. New scan starts gate index + 1.
Overlapping direct candidates: first completing main candle wins; within that candle choose smallest First index, not an independently ranked intrabar confirmation time.

Leg invalidation requires strict penetration. Same main candle race scans lower rows in order, invalidation before confirmation within each row. Absent decisive lower evidence defaults to invalidation.
Main stop query scans max(0,start) through end inclusive; returns whether first strict penetration belongs to end index.

Pending scale scans lower rows through Break end exclusive, stops after confirmation time (equality included). Add penetration before checking same-row breakout; first breakout with eligible evidence selects accumulated directional extreme, earliest on equal price.
A strict crossing window [start,end) or physical lower end. Nonempty lower window with no hit returns null. Empty lower window alone falls back to main starts selected by lower bounds.
A extreme range includes exact endpoints (end + one microsecond), rejects reversed bounds. Earliest equal extreme; absent lower rows uses complete owning main candles of both endpoints.
Scale Blue formation/stop scan use A's Break-open confirmation. Reset Blue forms at first strict lower Reset crossing or source open fallback; stop scan starts at source open + timeframe.
A selects first list position with confirmation >= trigger and optional First time >= not-before, using binary search only under ordered conditions.
S A-stop scan [max(start,range start),range end). Nonempty lower no-hit returns null. Empty lower window uses main starts >= original start within stage indices, duplicating main time as event.
Candidate event is first exact lower extreme equal to level in [max(source open,not-before),source open+timeframe). No equality hit returns max(source open,not-before), not proof of physical event.

S Order stop independent of candidate qualification. Candidate gate max(scan start,candidate start); nonfallback uses earliest available Reset Blue or strictly post-behavior ordinary trend confirmation, then max with gate. Compare lower positions, same-position joint hits reject. Earlier Order red, earlier candidate blue or fallback according to qualification.
No lower rows: S race starts at owning main candle and scans through stage end. Same main row with both hits rejects; otherwise Order red, qualified candidate blue, permitted unqualified fallback.
Order_B trusts precise Reset second_time through Reset resolver; otherwise requires strict crossing in Reset main [open,open+timeframe). Missing crossing returns null, no open fallback.
Order_B boundary includes both main endpoints; earliest equal extreme. Default strict crossing begins at upper bound of Reset timestamp (see 232–238).
Order_B sorts Reaction by confirmation, First, Break, ordinal/number; Reset by event time, from-First, ordinal. Reset exact event must exist.

Order_B latest post-stop and anchor strictly before Reset Reaction First main time; strict anchor extension and boundary source precedes First. Opposite First may equal strict-cross main; confirmation > exact crossing. Next A after First expires leg if A main index <= crossing main.

Order_A post-stop: First >= gate main, confirmation strictly later. Native search uses upper bound of stop on confirmations. Independent geometry may map to canonical identity or number zero; wins only if (First,confirmation) lexicographically earlier.
E first strict crossing is in half-open lower positions, indexed or linear; no main fallback in this primitive.
E parent-stop scans [max(source time,range start),range end). Parent and opposite Order have separate directional stop policies; optional continuation retains exact event and main owner.
E extreme uses full main candles containing parent and Order stops, both included and clamped to stage bounds. Lower events determine chronology without truncating boundary OHLC.

E four merged consumption routes: direct, inherited, carried, post-stop accepted; gate-owned lookup is not fifth stream. Earliest exact Order stop, then latest First. Reorder equal-stop accepted groups; reject disowned-S-only causes using prospective source. S with no carried route uses earliest inherited stop or range end as deadline.
E decision event is max(parent stop,Order stop). Source, decision, confirmation and stop remain separate.
StopAll strict stop starts inclusive, scans physical lower length; null if no hit. E dominance same family requires larger number, red dominates blue.
StopAll S/E iteration sorts (source time, kind string, source index); E before S on same source time, not physical intrarow order.

Armed stop normally strictly before boundary; E donor exception requires stop <= donor decision, either inside source main bucket with matching mapped index and strict directional price, or exact matching parent kind/index/time/price/stop event.
StopAll final strict-stop starts at decision or max(decision, optional after); absent crossing retains null stop fields.
Reversal uses confirmed physical number-three points; first strictly later crossing wins by (event time, source index, cycle ID or empty); bullish target PH3 upward, bearish target PL3 downward.

PH gate confirmation >= event irrespective of First; PL requires First >= gate main and confirmation > event. Primary strict cross excludes equal timestamp via upper bound; extreme main endpoints inclusive, earliest equal.
Primary seek: no hits waits, equal-time up/down ambiguous, else earliest sets phase. Cursor >= reversal cutoff waits before commitment.

Primary Orders stop strictly after confirmation; rank (stop event, negative First, Break). Earlier cancellation takes precedence, equal cancellation/winner ambiguous; opposing extreme in cancellation row may also make ambiguous. Post-PL3 accepts only stop before cancellation, no PL4. Source extreme gate main through stop main inclusive, committed cursor advances to stop event.

Projection horizon exclusive visible last start + timeframe. Recorded strict event verified only at same timestamp including duplicate lower times. Missing/unproven/late event null; no replacement search.

Independent segment main [start,stop), lower [first main,next main or final + duration); local indices reset, offset accumulated, visible bounds adjusted. Projection offsets nonnegative integer index fields and identity components, not timestamps.

Live accepts equal positive integer epochs, rejects descending; dirty lower rolls back one on equal timestamp, dirty main on same bucket. One-second timeframe shares frontier. Transaction on exception restores suffixes/time and removes new cached prices.

Append validation before transaction; request end moves to latest RAW time. Active path full replay from buckets; failure resets retained market views and rethrows. No generalized rollback of external callback effects.
Repair through endpoint included by upper bound; start inclusive; reference direction strict crossing; missing hit null.

Basic T/F starts first S and consumes supplied event order. Higher rank repairs prior singleton F starting current source time; repeated same-rank F removes old repair if >= current time then searches new repair. Engulf resets verdict count only.
StopAll verdict groups restart when number <= previous; parity from current verdict start. Repeat prefix requires prior-series or largest-prior-end match and confirmation closure if supplied.

T/F clears old annotations, excludes calculationValid=false, first row per source time wins in order directional Primary, StopAll, E, S. Sort selected by source time; Primary flushes StopAll verdict group. No native geometry changes.

Reversed outputs applied only if transition index <= visible end. Active direction chosen by maximal (segment start index,direction). Repair through = visible last start + duration - one second; closed-through min(through epoch + 1,last lower epoch + raw timeframe). StopAll closure decision epoch + timeframe <= closed-through.
